description: Na(SO₂)₄(BBr)₆ is Indium-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. The structure is zero-dimensional and consists of twenty-four BBr clusters and four Na(SO₂)₄ clusters. In each BBr cluster, B is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Br atom. The B-Br bond length is 1.96 Å. Br is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one B atom. In each Na(SO₂)₄ cluster, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.60 Å. There are four inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two O atoms. Both S-O bond lengths are 1.45 Å. In the second S site, S is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.45 Å) and one longer (1.46 Å) S-O bond length. In the third S site, S is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two O atoms. Both S-O bond lengths are 1.45 Å. In the fourth S site, S is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two O atoms. Both S-O bond lengths are 1.45 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Na and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one S atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one S atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one S atom.
